An original young woman with long, wavy blonde
hair sits on a gray backdrop. She wears a fitted
black cropped mock-neck long-sleeve top and
layered silver chain necklaces with a large
star-shaped pendant. Glossy black patent trousers
are cinched with a silver chain belt. Her expression
is calm and serious, with glossy pink lips. Soft,
even studio light with gentle shadow. Palette of
black, silver, and soft gray. Bold and edgy, in the
